# Swift Format Exclusions Configuration
# This file defines patterns for files and directories to exclude from Swift formatting
#
# Format:
#   name:<pattern>  - Exclude files matching the name pattern (e.g., *.pb.swift)
#   path:<pattern>  - Exclude files in paths matching the pattern (e.g., */Pods/*)
#
# Examples:
#   name:*.pb.swift
#   path:*/Pods/*

# Generated files
name:*.pb.swift

# Dependencies
path:*/Pods/*
path:*/Pods.xcodeproj/*

# Build directories
path:*/build/*
path:*/DerivedData/*
path:*/.build/*
path:*/output*/*
path:*/xcframework/*

# Git and metadata
path:*/.git/*
path:*/.swiftpm/*
path:*/xcuserdata/*
path:*/xcshareddata/*
path:*/Package.resolved*
